summary: Maggie, a Northern Colorado climber, was struck by boulder fragments at Happy Hour Crag in Poudre Canyon when a refrigerator-sized boulder broke loose above her and shattered against the cliff; fractured pelvis and severe internal bleeding, stranded 300 feet up a remote cliffside; Poudre Fire Authority Engine 7 plus Captain Ryan Thomas and Larimer County Search and Rescue reached her, carried her across the frozen Poudre River to a helicopter that flew her to a hospital; she fully recovered and returned to climbing.
responding_agency: Poudre Fire Authority; Larimer County Search and Rescue
notes: DATE PINNED to victim's own account: Maggie Dring's Mountain Project forum post (dated 2024-02-01) says "Last Sunday I went up to happy hour crag" -> 2024-01-28 (Sunday-verified), replacing the earlier month-only pin. Prior note: North Forty News retrospective pinned January 2024 only; she was honored at the 2nd Annual EMS Survivors Celebration during National EMS Week 2025.
